THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The sign

As you record, the four moves fill in. A whole turn is 360 degrees. Divide it by one turn.

THE SCENE

You made a museum wall for family night. The big star quilt is already hanging. You are alone at the wall. The sign next to it is still empty. You need four moves for the sign. Four people each can help you.

THE HISTORY

This wall is about Lakota star quilts. Families give them as gifts at big events. One big star is made from many small diamonds. The same diamond turns around the center again and again.
